comparison_with_other_richard_mille_coun: The fake-image P(fake) distribution has p5 0.999637 and median 0.999839. The inspected errors are the lower tail, not the typical counterfeit score.
duplicate_rule: Exact groups are singleton paths. Nearest dHash Hamming distances are 8 to 19. The locked near-duplicate rule grouped Hamming 0 only.
findings: No inspected error shares an exact duplicate group with another brand or with an authentic Richard Mille image.
The lowest score, P(fake) 0.000274, is a multi-panel advertisement sheet rather than a single watch photograph.
All fifteen files are already 512x512 RGB catalog images. Source and marketplace metadata are UNKNOWN.
Nine of the fifteen persisted errors have P(fake) below 0.01.
hypotheses_not_findings: Studio product photographs of tonneau skeleton watches resemble the authentic Richard Mille photography in the training brands, so the head assigns them very low P(fake).
The head is not using legible brand text. Several low-scoring images have broken or misspelled wordmarks and are still scored authentic.

Some folder-labeled Richard Mille counterfeits are other case shapes, including a round octagonal-bezel chronograph and square cases. That may be a label or brand-bucket problem. It was not independently re-labeled.
not_persisted_reason: The fold stored the 15 lowest P(fake) counterfeit examples. The other five false-authentic identities were not written, and the fold checkpoint was not retained.
